name: Phone feed, scrolled past
description: A black phone on the clean background shows a vertical-video feed ('For You' tab) playing the speaker's own video with a heart / comment / share column and counts, a username and caption; a finger swipes it up and away to a dim loading next video, then a white card pops over the phone's lower right with a small label, a low value (e.g. 0.4%) falling, a red '▼ 82%' chip and a falling sparkline.
use_when: Lines about content that flops or gets skipped: 'people scroll right past it', 'nobody watches', 'you won't get the engagement', low views, low reach, weak hooks.

username.help: handle shown on the video; '@' is added if missing

caption.help: one caption line under the username (an 'original sound' line follows it)

likes.help: count under the heart, e.g. '12' or '4.1K'

swipe.help: the viewer swipes the video away, leaving a dim next item

card_value.help: the value on the card; if it is a number it counts down to it

card_delta.help: size of the drop shown in the red chip ('82%'); empty = no card
